report:
Reviewed meta.book.browser_search's complete claim and all associated evidence. The sole implementation association and sole test association are the explicit todo::browser_searches_entities_and_combines_filters region in spec_plan.rs. Its body is only a TODO comment and contains no behavioral assertions; the anchor remains deferred rather than implemented or tested. No N/A or ordinary evidence is associated. No behavior tests were executed in this review.

The complete obligation includes matching names, qualified model paths, descriptive prose and available corresponding Rust paths; combining text with crate and kind filters; identifying result kinds and owners; direct entity links including named members; an explicit no-results state; and stable/openable links even when current filtering excludes the target. The TODO explicitly names members, prose, model/Rust paths, combined filters, empty results and opening entities outside active results. The unmentioned-by-name basic name matching and result identity are part of that same search-result fixture prerequisite, not independently established coverage.

I captured and inspected web/browser.js to assess existing components and the concrete deferral. buildModel retains crate/module/item/method/member maps with qualified keys and owner/kind metadata, including fields and variants. searchModel lowercases and trims the query and combines crate/kind predicates with matching against keys, descriptions and available Rust target paths. navigation groups matching entities, emits owner-qualified labels for members/methods, kind labels and entityRoute links, and displays a No matches message when no result markup exists. Rendering resolves routes against the complete model rather than the filtered result array; search/filter listeners update navigation while direct hash navigation invokes the renderer independently. These source paths suggest the intended structure but are not a replacement for associated meaningful test assertions.

Replacing this TODO requires a fixture with multiple crates and entity kinds, methods and named members, overlapping names, distinctive prose and optional Rust correspondences. Tests must assert exact result sets for each search field and combined filters, result owner/kind labels and target routes, empty-result messaging, and opening a direct link whose target is excluded before and after filter changes. Browser interaction checks should exercise both standalone and embedded navigation where relevant. Until that evidence exists, current implementation completeness and interaction correctness are not established by this report. The explicit TODO honestly defers the complete search behavior matrix, so no source change or additional requested edit is necessary for this review.
